full_prompt_en: A square oil-like portrait study shows a young woman from the upper chest upward, her dark hair loosely gathered back as she lowers her eyes toward the right. The pale background is not a literal room. It is assembled from broken cream, white, gray, and muted brown patches, with faint drawn lines and scraped marks that remain visible around the figure. A few darker rectangular flecks appear near the left and upper edges, but no legible text or clear object takes attention from the face. Her head occupies the central upper half, slightly turned so one cheek is seen more fully than the other. Soft, dark brown hair wraps over the crown and around her temples, with short loose strands near the ear and a gathered mass behind the left side of her head. The eyelids and brows follow her lowered gaze, while a small nose and relaxed, closed lips are modeled with subtle warm-cool changes. Rose touches enliven the cheeks and mouth. Her neck descends into a loose white blouse with an open, irregular neckline; broad cream and cool gray strokes only partly resolve its folds and shoulders. The right shoulder blends into the light background, while darker accents around the hair and throat keep the face distinct. Brushwork across the skin is comparatively smooth, but the garment and surrounding ground retain palette-knife-like smears, scratches, and gaps where underlayers show through. Warm light from the upper right touches the forehead, cheek, and collarbone, leaving the side of the neck and hair in gentler brown shadow. The overall composition lets a quiet downward glance emerge from a busy, pale painted surface, balancing delicate skin tones against energetic, unfinished marks.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形、近似油画的人物习作呈现一位胸部以上入画的年轻女子，深色头发松松地向后挽起，眼睛朝右下方垂落。浅色背景不是具体房间，而由断续的奶油、白、灰和低饱和棕色斑块组成，人物周围仍可见淡淡画线与刮擦痕迹。左侧和上边缘有少量较暗的矩形碎块，但没有可读文字或明确物件从面孔夺去注意力。她的头部位于中央上半部，略微侧转，使一侧面颊比另一侧更完整可见。柔软的深棕头发覆在头顶与太阳穴周围，耳旁有几缕散发，头部左后方收成一团。眼睑与眉毛顺着下垂的目光，细小鼻子和放松闭合的嘴唇由微妙的冷暖变化塑造。玫瑰色轻轻点亮脸颊与嘴部。脖颈向下进入一件宽松白上衣，不规则的开领周围，宽阔的奶油色和冷灰笔触只让褶皱与肩部部分成形。右肩与浅背景融合，头发和喉部附近较暗的强调仍让面部清楚。皮肤上的笔触相对平滑，衣服和周围底色则保留近似刮刀的抹痕、刮线和露出底层的间隙。暖光从右上方照到前额、面颊与锁骨，颈侧和头发落在更柔和的棕影里。整体构图让安静的低垂目光从繁忙的浅色绘画表面中浮现，使细腻肤色与活跃、未完全收束的笔痕取得平衡。
style_prompt_en: The painting mixes carefully observed focal modeling with free, partly unresolved strokes in the surrounding areas. Warm cream, chalk white, gray, and earthy brown form a luminous broken ground, while a smaller dark mass and subtle rose accents steady the center. Edges shift from soft blends to scraped, angular breaks, allowing one area to emerge clearly while another sinks back into the surface. Fine exploratory lines remain visible beneath broader paint passages, and patches of underpainting show through. Light is gentle and directional, modeling the focal planes with small warm highlights rather than a sharp spotlight. The space is compressed and shallow, so attention stays on the meeting of form and mark. The overall effect is intimate, tactile, and deliberately open-ended.
style_prompt_zh: 这种绘画把经细致观察的焦点塑形与周围更自由、部分未收束的笔触混合起来。暖奶油、粉白、灰与土棕形成发亮而断续的底色，较小的深色块和细微玫瑰红强调稳定中央。边缘从柔和融合转成刮擦般的棱角断裂，使一处清楚浮现，另一处沉回画面表面。更宽阔的颜料段落下面仍可见纤细探索线，局部底色透出。光线温和而有方向，以小小的暖亮部塑造焦点平面，而非强烈聚光。空间被压得较浅，注意力停留在形体与笔痕的交会处。整体效果亲近、可感，并有意保留未完全封闭的状态。
theme_en: A young woman with dark hair looking downward in a softly painted study
theme_zh: 一位深发年轻女子在柔和绘制的习作中低头凝视
name: Richard Schmid
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
